Week 23 Module Map: Civic Duties and Offices

Quarter 3: The Price of Union

The government you studied last week comes with duties and with real people who filled it. This week is about citizenship and Texans who led.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: Civics Duties in Texas
  • Lesson 2: Texas Leaders in Action

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 23 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 23 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 23 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Responsibility and service: notice them in Sam Rayburn, Henry B. González, Barbara Jordan, and Kay Bailey Hutchison.
